title: meta-harness: a reproducible, audited meta-analysis pipeline (Mahmood Ahmad)
description: A reproducible meta-analysis pipeline. Each of 32 reviews is built by committed code from a committed protocol and a committed cache of open sources (PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov / AACT, open-access full text) and served as a web page with every step on a tab and a certificate of digests that a replay must reproduce byte for byte. Live reviews: https://mahmood726-cyber.github.io/meta-harness/ . External audit in progress: https://mahmood726-cyber.github.io/meta-harness/audit/ . Not the Zenodo record 'Meta Harness' (10.5281/zenodo.22541807), which is a different project.
